name: Form Depricarping
implementation_notes: REVISED 2026-08-24 (entity-catalog v12, replacing the original fixed 24-row design the user explicitly rejected as wasting screen space): Depricarping Detail grid now renders whatever rows exist (0..24) loaded from depricarpingRecordRepo.getDraftWithDetails(), with Tambah baris/Hapus baris controls -- the exact same dynamic add-row/remove-row pattern as Pressing Detail (screen-042, just fixed)/Threshing Detail (screen-041)/Cages Tipped Time (screen-012), no longer a structural difference from those grids

STRUCTURAL DIFFERENCE handled explicitly, UNAFFECTED by this revision: 8 reading columns per row (7 numeric + Downtime (Mins) as a separate numeric field + Findings as a separate free-text field), instead of Threshing's/Pressing's single free-text 'Downtime Reason' column -- isRowFilled()/validateDetailRows() in both the repo and this view check all 8 columns, with downtime_minutes and findings each independently sufficient to satisfy the minimum-one-row rule (which now also requires a selected Time-Slot, same as Pressing/Threshing)

Target Operasional reference table sourced from a STATIC constant (mobile/src/data/depricarpingOperationalTargets.ts, created under screen-039) rather than a synced local reference table -- UNTOUCHED by this revision, same judgment call already documented for Threshing/Pressing; STRUCTURAL DIFFERENCE: this table renders 4 columns (Parameter/Metric, Target Range, Critical Limit, Operational Consequence/Justification) instead of Threshing's/Pressing's 3 columns, matching the entity-catalog's own 4-field shape for this station

'Minimal 1 baris valid' (Time-Slot terpilih + minimal 1 dari 8 kolom bacaan terisi) validated at FE + repo level (depricarpingRecordRepo.saveDraft() throws DepricarpingDetailRequiredError) -- NOT enforced by the server model's DepricarpingRecord::booted() saving guard, which only checks row EXISTENCE (now meaningfully true only once the user has added at least one row, since rows are no longer pre-created), same pattern already fixed for Threshing/Pressing

availableTimeSlotOptions() compares slots by their index in canonicalTimeSlots() rather than a raw hour number (since slots wrap starting at 07:00, not 0-23) -- the one structural difference from Cages Tipped Time's availableHourOptions(), otherwise the floor/exclusion logic is identical to Pressing's/Threshing's just-fixed version

Every FormField id in the grid is set explicitly (e.g. fan-static-pressure-{index}, downtime-minutes-{index}, findings-{index}) to avoid duplicate DOM ids across rows sharing the same label text -- FormField.vue's default id-from-label slug would otherwise collide
Time-Slot per row is now a SearchableSelect.vue instance (was a read-only label) -- mirrors FormPressingView.vue exactly, WITH pendingDeletionIds for existing (has-id) rows removed via Hapus baris

REVISI (tech-spec v3, kunci periode usecase-141 — sinkronisasi artefak): FormDepricarpingView menyimpan ke SQLite lokal tanpa memeriksa periode; satu-satunya panggilan server dari form ini adalah write-through syncAfterSave('depricarping_record') → pushSavedRecordNow → POST /api/depricarping-records bila Mills Setting immediate_sync_enabled aktif. Penolakannya (termasuk 422 PERIOD_CLOSED) sejak 2026-10-03 ditampilkan langsung di form (lihat catatan REVISI 2026-10-03); di sinkron manual screen-006 alasannya tampil per record di SyncResultDialog. Guard EnforcesPeriodLock::assertPeriodOpenForWrite('depricarping', mill, date) di DepricarpingRecordService::create() menilai periode saat request tiba (bukan saat dicatat). Form hanya membuka draft lokal; tidak ada jalur edit/PATCH record tersinkron dari mobile. Cakupan: backend/tests/Unit/Support/EnforcesPeriodLockTest.php (aturan whitelist + 'ke-18 *RecordService memanggil guard pada create MAUPUN update'), backend/tests/Feature/Api/KelolaPeriodePelaporanTest.php ('menolak 422 PERIOD_CLOSED untuk data mobile yang menyusul, lalu menerimanya setelah periode dibuka kembali'), mobile/tests/syncService.spec.ts (gagal per record dengan reason dari server, galat generik), dan mobile/tests/writeThroughSync.spec.ts.

REVISI (2026-10-03): penolakan write-through kini ditampilkan — writeThroughSync.syncAfterSave() mengembalikan {synced, rejection}; respons server 4xx (mis. 422 PERIOD_CLOSED) mengisi rejection dengan pesan server, sedangkan offline/5xx/fitur nonaktif tetap {synced:false, rejection:null} dan diam. onSimpan() FormDepricarpingView menyimpan pesan itu ke writeThroughRejection, menampilkan ConfirmDialog satu tombol (cancel-label="") berjudul 'Tersimpan, tetapi ditolak server' dengan pesan server, dan baru bernavigasi ke monitor-depricarping saat dialog ditutup (Mengerti atau klik overlay). Record tetap 'saved' di SQLite lokal, tidak ada rollback. Test: mobile/tests/writeThroughSync.spec.ts ('reports the server message when the push is rejected with 422 PERIOD_CLOSED' + kasus diam); tidak ada test per-form untuk dialog ini di layar Depricarping — pola identik dengan Threshing yang dicakup mobile/tests/FormThreshingView.spec.ts.

REVISI (2026-10-03, run penuh Playwright mobile 430 lulus / 0 gagal): mobile/tests/e2e/form-depricarping.spec.ts 10/10 lulus — kini dijalankan nyata (known_issue 'tidak dapat dijalankan di sandbox' dihapus). Perbaikan spec (drift, bukan cacat aplikasi): tabel Target Operasional berada di CollapsibleSection yang tertutup secara default (disengaja, 2026-08-25) — spec kini membukanya dulu sebelum meng-assert isi tabel.

REVISI (2026-10-04, audit-fix — sinkronisasi artefak, kode adalah acuan): depricarpingRecordRepo.createDraft() menyimpan date = todayLocalDateString() (mobile/src/utils/localDate.ts; sebelumnya ISO UTC → draft 00:00–06:59 WIB bertanggal kemarin); FormDepricarpingView: catatan berlabel 'Catatan' dengan id field-note. Write-through syncAfterSave() kini benar-benar berjalan saat immediate_sync_enabled aktif karena millSettingRepo.getMillSetting() men-SELECT immediate_sync_enabled (sebelumnya selalu false). Payload sinkron (manual & write-through) mengirim date lokal dan production line stasiun record; 4xx menulis sync_error (Data Preview 'Gagal sinkron'), sukses mengosongkannya. ConfirmDialog (termasuk dialog penolakan write-through) di-teleport ke <body>. Server DepricarpingRecordService menolak date > besok. Cakupan baru: writeThroughSync.spec.ts (disesuaikan), millSettingRepo.sqljs.spec.ts, syncService.sqljs.spec.ts (#4/#5/#9), noteLabelConsistency.spec.ts, DialogTeleport.spec.ts; tidak ada uji createDraft tanggal-lokal khusus Depricarping (localDate.sqljs.spec.ts hanya menguji Threshing — kode identik).

REVISI (2026-10-05, audit loading state commit d5da9cf, desain filter e4f231e + dok mengambang ee5294c — sinkronisasi artefak, kode adalah acuan): FormDepricarpingView.vue — penjaga aksi ganda: onSimpan/onPause/onClearConfirm langsung kembali bila actionInProgress, sehingga ketukan kedua yang tiba sebelum Vue merender ulang tombol tidak lagi menyimpan/mengirim dua kali; router.push ke Monitor kini di-await DI DALAM aksi agar tombol tetap sibuk sampai layar berganti. Tombol Pause/Clear/Simpan memakai BusyLabel (spinner + 'Menyimpan…'/'Menghapus…', aria-busy; tombol yang bekerja tetap berwarna penuh, yang ikut terkunci redup); pemuatan draft memakai LoadingState variant form (test-id form-loading) menggantikan teks status. SearchableSelect (komponen bersama) kini menampilkan chevron, tanda centang pada opsi terpilih, dan baris opsi 44px — perilaku & testid tetap. Bubble AI/jam kini duduk di dok bawah buram App.vue sehingga footer tidak tertutup pada posisi gulir mana pun. Dijaga berkas uji BERSAMA mobile/tests/loadingStates.screens.spec.ts, mobile/tests/filterComponents.spec.ts dan mobile/tests/e2e/floating-safe-area.spec.ts (lulus per commit ee5294c); tidak ada berkas uji khusus layar ini yang berubah.
